decisions.issues: v03 (newest) is clean on the script beat. Varma is bare-headed with a bun, no turban or crest, has the Vaishnavite forehead lines, is bare-chested with one cream-and-gold cloth over his shoulder and gold necklaces, and stands at the edge of the one-pole awning. Ramayyan (thin, receding hair, white cloth) sits on his stool marking a palm leaf. Nagoji swings down from a grey: rust-red turban, thick curled moustache, clean-shaven chin, cream tunic, red cloth, sand-caked boots and trousers. There is no painted text and no painted balloons, and the upper-right sky is wide open for Varma's balloon. Minor faults left for the author: (1) Nagoji's ear ornament is a small hanging gold bead, not a flat stud, visible at print size. (2) Nagoji wears a thin gold bracelet on his left wrist (bible: no royal jewellery; a simple bangle is borderline). (3) Nagoji's red cloth is draped from the shoulder across his chest into the waist, not the sheet's broad waist sash. It still reads as his red sash. (4) Varma's bun sits at the back of his head, not clearly above his left ear. (5) The grey is dappled, not plain grey, and its head is cropped by the right frame edge. Backup v02 has the same figures, but its background shows a European-style fortified town with towers and sailing ships. That does not match the empty training beach of this sequence or the 'no ships' sea of 8.4.
decisions.correction: A small local pixel retouch fixes the worst fault. On Nagoji's visible earlobe, at about x=0.744, y=0.395 of the v03 frame (around pixel 1143,404), shrink the hanging gold bead into a small flat gold stud sitting on the lobe, and paint skin and hair over the part that hangs below it. Optionally, remove the thin gold bracelet on his left wrist at about x=0.69, y=0.645 by painting over it with skin tone.

decisions.issues: v03 (newest) is clean on the hard checks: Nagoji matches the commander sheet (rust-red turban, long curly hair, thick curled moustache, clean-shaven chin, small gold ear stud visible, cream tunic, red sash, cream trousers, boots). He is seen from behind on a dappled grey riding down the slope toward the wet sand. The mixed line waits with their horses side by side: white-turbaned Madurai lancers on dark bay or black horses, bare-headed Maravar men on dun or brown ponies. Surf is breaking on the incoming tide. There is no painted text, balloon, fort or anachronism, and the anatomy is sound. The open sky in the upper centre and right takes both captions without covering any face. Minor faults for the author: (1) the Madurai chargers are about the same height as the Maravar ponies, where they should read as taller and heavier; (2) Nagoji's slope is rocky with scrub, while the selected 9.1 shows a grassy slope (the beach and sea match); (3) the riders sit stiffly in one rank facing the viewer, rather than looking winded and 'catching their breath'. v02 is the same composition but puts forts on the headland, which neither 9.1 nor the script has, so it is the backup only.
